# Global agent guidance

Personal defaults applied to every Codex session on this machine.

- Prefer small, reviewable diffs; explain anything non-obvious.
- Never run destructive git commands without asking.
- When a repo has its own AGENTS.md, its instructions win over this file.

# Codex CLI project config
model = "gpt-5-codex"
approval_policy = "on-request"
sandbox_mode = "workspace-write"
model_reasoning_effort = "medium"

[sandbox_workspace_write]
network_access = false

[mcp_servers.docs]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "docs-mcp-server"]

[mcp_servers.docs.env]
DOCS_ROOT = "./docs"

[profiles.fast]
model = "gpt-5-codex-mini"
approval_policy = "never"
